newsitem.title: GERMANY: TENNIS-SINGING SPANIARD CORRETJA CLAIMS STUTTGART CROWN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SINGING SPANIARD CORRETJA CLAIMS STUTTGART CROWN.

text.p: Spain's Alex Corretja defeated unseeded Karol Kucera of Slovakia 6-2 7-5 on Sunday to win the Stuttgart clay-court tournament and then served up a song for the spectators.
Third seed Corretja used the public address system to serenade the crowd with a version of "La Bamba" after an invitation from the stadium announcer.
The final was the second match of the day for both players. They first had to contest semifinals held over from Saturday because of heavy rain.
Corretja defeated ninth-seeded fellow Spaniard Albert Costa 6-4 6-4 in his semifinal while Kucera beat unseeded Albert Portas 6-4 6-3 to prevent an all-Spanish final.
